scenarios.resource_description: 4 hypothetical teams; at most 2 per airport. Each serves up to 2 scheduled legs and removes at most 15 minutes from the external delay floor; aircraft readiness remains binding.
scenarios.note: Fixed 16:00 UTC scenario, independent of the replay cursor. Denominator: all WN domestic completed legs scheduled in the following 8h; resources are restricted to eight focal airports. Baseline replay MAE on this day: 26.6 min across 2,015 completed flights. Full held-out replay late15 recall: 11.2%; tail events are poorly represented. Actual-tail topology uses hindsight; no cancellation recovery, causal savings or airline staffing claim.
